query: Run the eval-pipeline pipeline on sample liver_rep1 on Flow.
expected_behavior: Calls GET /me and confirms `id` is non-null before preparing the run. Running a pipeline always requires the token.
Discovers the pipeline by name in GET /pipelines and picks the default version, the first entry of `versions` from GET /pipelines/<pipeline_id>, since the user did not name one.
Fetches GET /pipelines/versions/<version_id> and finds that its schema has no parameters, so it has no input that takes a sample.
Tells the user that this pipeline takes no sample input, so liver_rep1 cannot be attached to the run; does NOT invent a samplesheet or other parameter to carry it.
Picks the Nextflow version `23.04.3`, the first entry of the version's `nextflow_versions`.
Does NOT submit the run POST without the user's explicit confirmation; shows what it would send, or asks whether to run the pipeline without the sample.
Does NOT offer to poll the run, since the user did not ask to be told when it finishes.
